# Controlled CAD regression fixtures

Generated by `tests/occt_corpus.cpp` using Open CASCADE 8.0.1, then serialized
through STEPControl_Writer and BRepTools. The source constructs independent CAD
topology; these are not exported meshes disguised as CAD.

Sixteen named fixtures have both STEP and BRep versions. The generator builds
the shapes from dimensions and Open CASCADE primitives and records independent
expected volumes in the test.

The planar adapter uses the cylinder, sphere and two-solid assembly to test
unsupported-input refusal. The native STEP CLI uses the cylinder for curved
face and volume sizing and tagged solver export. `malformed.brep` exercises
parser failure. Shape metadata and STEP timestamps may change when regenerated.
See [asset provenance](../../../docs/ASSET_PROVENANCE.md) for the reproduction
check.

Regenerate after configuring `PAACS_WITH_OCCT=ON`:

```sh
build/gcc16-release/tests/paacs-occt-corpus --fixtures tests/fixtures/cad
```
